## Release Impact

<!-- Version selection, tags and publication belong to the release workflow.
     Do not bump the version in an ordinary PR: two concurrent PRs that both
     touch the version file conflict for no reason.

     CHANGELOG.md is generated by Release Please from commit messages, so
     hand-edits are overwritten. This repository squash-merges, so the
     subject Release Please sees is the squash commit subject, which
     defaults to this pull request's title. Give the PR a Conventional
     Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` ...) rather than relying on the
     messages on your branch. -->

- [ ] This change affects the public API, supported versions, or generated output
- [ ] I have updated `PRD.md` if product scope or goals changed
- [ ] Notes the release owner should act on:
